description: Save a credential (BYOK provider API key). Saved keys persist across sessions and are used automatically.

is_default.description: Set this value as the default for this credential.

label.description: Human-readable label to identify this value (e.g. "MyApp", "Staging"). Required when saving multiple values for the same credential.

name.description: Credential name from the tool requirements (e.g. "ios_app_id", "openai").

name: credential_save
title: Save Credential
